build_LossTexture: build a LossTexture module with a pretrained VGG19 model to compute style transfer texture loss
run_getLoss: run getLoss to compute the MSE texture loss between fake and real image feature representations
run_getFeatures: run getFeatures to extract mean and variance statistics from VGG feature maps at multiple scales
run_extractRelUIndexes: run extractRelUIndexes to find ReLU layer indices in a Sequential model matching target scale layers
run_extractIndexedLayers: run extractIndexedLayers to forward an input tensor through selected layers and collect intermediate activations
